explanation: Mathlib has `Nat.factorization_gcd`, which identifies the factorization of a gcd with the pointwise infimum of the two factorizations, and provides the `ordCompl` decomposition lemmas. I found no declaration stating this gcd-splitting identity; deriving it from those ingredients requires more than the permitted short glue. The proof instead uses the library’s own `TauCeti.Nat.gcd_pow_mul_pow_mul`.
